platform_adaptations.note: Desktop helper windows/binaries and macOS/JavaFX/VLC/MPV helper-process packaging excluded by current contract. Existing Android integrated player/external chooser is the relevant platform adaptation; do not create desktop targets to clear historical partial strings.
Live-channel-specific timeline semantics excluded with live channels; do not re-add live UI.
Original community/vendor links excluded; independent app-information sharing is implemented and tested.

Server/account playlist mutation is excluded. Explicit episode watched markers and private device-local collection membership remain retained; current local collection/state implementations were inspected. This is not server playlist parity.
User-reported original delivered video playback is not current-build hardware verification. Current code uses media_kit/libmpv; exact ExoPlayer implementation is not claimed.
Scoped content-URI export/share is the required Android adaptation for app-private downloaded-file reveal.
Only generic media embeds retained, not vendor shop/support/news/updater browser destinations.
